stories.headline: Friday Pressers
stories.deck: Luka Vušković fit again for Brighton, with Hadjam back and Dunk a rotation doubt
stories.body:
Fabian Hurzeler declared Luka Vušković fit again and back in contention, Brighton's clearest gain before the deadline. He stopped short of naming a line-up, and left Lewis Dunk's involvement open with rotation on the table.

Jaouen Hadjam returns alongside Vušković, so Hurzeler has options restored at the back that he did not have a week ago.

teamNews.line: Unai Emery ruled out Marco Bizot and left a question mark over Joao Gomes.
Harry Wilson goes into the weekend under a cloud.
Nothing new from Crystal Palace ahead of the deadline.
Kenny Tete will not feature for Fulham.
Nothing new from Ipswich Town.
No fresh word from Liverpool.
Manchester United added nothing to a settled list.
Nothing new from Sunderland.
David Moyes ruled Merlin Röhl out without detailing the reason.
Roberto De Zerbi left Pedro Porro's involvement in doubt.
Mikel Arteta welcomed two men back into contention.
Fabian Hurzeler had two fit again and stopped short of committing to Lewis Dunk.

stories.headline: Thursday Pressers
stories.deck: João Pedro a Chelsea doubt for the deadline, no complaint given
stories.body:
João Pedro sits as a doubt for Chelsea, with Xabi Alonso stopping short of clearing him and giving no update on what keeps him on the edge of it.

Whether test211's man features is a decision left open, and nothing said points to a timescale.

teamNews.line: Xabi Alonso would not commit either way on João Pedro before the deadline.
Matthias Jaissle flagged Amar Dedic as a fitness question.
Sergej Jakirovic left Matt Targett uncertain for the weekend.
Frank Lampard ruled Aurèle Amenda out entirely.
Nothing new came out of Nottingham Forest.
Brentford added nothing to their list.

stories.headline: Lawro's Predictions: GW6
stories.deck: Lawro goes against the favourites in test3 v test2, and leaves test4 v 123 to the front-runners.
stories.body: First column here, and no record to answer for yet. That comes soon enough. Twenty-two years of Saturday scores on the BBC, and now this. Preston weather, then.

ties.line: test3 are the favourites, and I fancy test2 anyway. Why? Isak. He is up against Manchester City, a tough defence, and none of that bothers a Liverpool man one bit. Gonzalo of Fulham has gone quiet for test3, no goal and no assist in his last two. Havertz of Arsenal has done the same for test2, so that pair cancel out. Both lost last week. Sitting through this one will feel like waiting for a bus that never turns up. I'll go with test2.

123 top the table and look the part. Haaland of Manchester City has scored in each of his last two. Good news? Not for test4. Mbeumo of Manchester United has gone dry for test4, no goal and no assist in two. Fernandes of Manchester United, same story for 123, so it's not all one way. Foden is suspended for test4, and that's that. Both sides came off a win last week. I'd be surprised if the front-runners slipped here. 123 for me.

stories.headline: Gross profit for 123 at the front
stories.deck: 123 lead test2 26-16

matchups.standfirst: Brighton midfielder Pascal Gross gave 123 a goal and an assist on Saturday.
paragraphs: Saturday brought returns at both ends. Newcastle defender Lewis Hall scored for test2, eight points in all. Gross added his goal and his assist for 123, and the gap came down from 11 to 10.

Millar did not play for test2, so Sunderland defender Thomas Meunier comes on if he plays, away to Man City on Sunday. James Trafford is at home to Crystal Palace, and Trai Hume travels for 123. test2 have four still to play, 123 five.

matchups.standfirst: test3 built the lead in two stages, first in the day's play and then off the bench.
paragraphs: test3 scored 15 to test4's five, with Everton goalkeeper Jordan Pickford keeping a shut-out for seven points. That made it 15-5.

The reserves widened it. Ipswich Town defender Leif Davis returned two points for test4, in for a man who did not play. Luka Vuskovic kept a clean sheet for test3, nine points to two that pushed the gap from 10 to 17.
James Justin is at home to Crystal Palace for test4, and Harry Maguire goes to Fulham for test3. test4 have seven men left and test3 three.

stories.headline: test3 beat test4 33-28
stories.deck: 123 beat test2 38-37

matchups.standfirst: test3 beat test4 33-28.
123 edged it by a single point, and one goal from Erling Haaland made all the difference.
paragraphs: Friday gave 123 an early cushion at 11-0. test2 answered on Saturday, Newcastle defender Lewis Hall scoring for eight to begin the chase, though Pascal Gross replied with a goal and an assist for an 11-point haul, and the margin held at 26-16.

Sunday brought the fightback properly alive. James Trafford kept a shut-out, Alexander Isak scored, and Matheus Cunha added another in the 89th minute. Haaland answered for 123 in the 81st, his six points holding the gap at four, 38-34. Thomas Meunier then laid one on among the substitutions to close it to 38-37.

test2 won three of the four stages and still lost. Reinildo did not play for 123, available again now his one-match suspension is served. test2 fell to third and 123 rose to second. test2 play test3 next, 123 face test4.

stories.headline: Brobbey's treble no robbery
stories.deck: Manchester City beat Sunderland 5-3

reports.standfirst: Manchester City beat Sunderland 5-3 to stay top with a fifth win running, Brian Brobbey's hat-trick counting for nothing.
reports.account:
Brian Brobbey scored three times for Sunderland and finished on the losing side.
Nilson Angulo shot wide from inside the box after Enzo Le Fée crossed, in the 6th minute.
Enzo Fernández put Manchester City ahead after nine minutes, and Brobbey answered three minutes later, taking a through ball from Le Fée.
Erling Haaland shot off target from inside the six-yard box after Iliman Ndiaye's cross.
Rayan Cherki restored the City lead in the 29th minute from an Antoine Semenyo pass, before Brobbey levelled again, Thomas Meunier supplying him after 33 minutes.
Semenyo made it 3-2 just before half-time, finishing a Marc Guéhi pass from a corner.
Semenyo struck again after 57 minutes, and Brobbey completed his hat-trick two minutes later, set up by Angulo from a set piece.
Rúben Dias headed a Fernández corner off target midway through the second half.
Haaland settled it with nine minutes left, taking a pass from Josko Gvardiol for 5-3.

sections.head: Semenyo among the goals
sections.pitch: Semenyo made three chances across the match and set up the third City goal.
sections.stake: He is test1's man and returned 13 points.

sections.head: Haaland strikes late
sections.pitch: Haaland had four shots in all, one of them the goal that ended the scoring.
sections.stake: He belongs to 123 for six points, and 123 lead test2 38-34 in their head-to-head this period.

sections.head: Gvardiol makes fifth
sections.pitch: Gvardiol laid on the fifth for Haaland.
sections.stake: He was on test31121's bench, so those points did not count.

reports.standfirst: Liverpool won 1-0 at AFC Bournemouth through Alexander Isak, extending their unbeaten start to five and leaving the hosts still chasing a first win.
reports.account:
Evanilson was denied from six yards after 18 minutes, Marcus Tavernier the maker with a cross.
Bradley Barcola forced a save after 33 minutes, Alexander Isak the supplier.
Ryan Christie dragged wide from close range after 53 minutes, Rayan crossing.
Isak settled it after 57 minutes, Liverpool's only goal from three efforts on target.
AFC Bournemouth carved out one clear opening and did not take it.

sections.head: Wirtz withdrawn
sections.pitch: Wirtz made three chances before he was taken off.
sections.stake: He belongs to test1, for whom he scored six points.

sections.head: Christie starts
sections.pitch: Christie made his first league start of the season, had four shots and was then taken off.
sections.stake: He is a free agent.

reports.standfirst: Leeds United and Crystal Palace drew 0-0, Palace keeping their first clean sheet of the season.
reports.account:
Tarik Muharemovic headed a corner off target after eight minutes, Anton Stach crossing.
Jefferson Lerma shot off target from close range from a corner early in the second half.
Tyrick Mitchell had the ball in the net after 52 minutes, only for a video review to rule it out.
Dominic Calvert-Lewin had openings for Leeds and did not take them.
Daichi Kamada headed wide from inside the six-yard box with five minutes left.

sections.head: Trafford keeps it clean
sections.pitch: Trafford made five saves for his clean sheet.
sections.stake: He is test2's keeper for seven points, though 123 lead test2 38-34 in their head-to-head this period.

sections.head: Muharemovic shoots often
sections.pitch: Muharemovic had four shots across the match.
sections.stake: He was on test211's bench.

reports.standfirst: Fulham drew 1-1 with Manchester United, conceding one minute from time to stay in the bottom three and without a win this season.
reports.account:
Gonzalo García shot off target after four minutes, Antonee Robinson the maker.
Bryan Mbeumo headed wide after 11 minutes, Marcus Rashford crossing from a corner.
Bruno Fernandes struck the woodwork after 25 minutes.
Lisandro Martínez turned into his own net after 63 minutes to put Fulham ahead.
Patrick Dorgu came on with six minutes left and had a hand in the leveller.
One minute from time Matheus Cunha drew United level, taking Dorgu's pass and striking it right-footed from outside the box, low into the corner.
Dorgu then headed over from six yards in stoppage time, Mbeumo delivering the cross.
Fulham managed a single goal from six efforts on target and made three clear chances without a return.

sections.head: Cunha finds the corner
sections.pitch: Cunha had three shots and created three chances besides his goal.
sections.stake: He is test2's, and six points spares them a blank.

sections.head: Iwobi creates plenty
sections.pitch: Iwobi made five chances for Fulham before he was taken off.
sections.stake: A free agent.

stories.headline: Spurs left with van Hecke of a comeback
stories.deck: Aston Villa won 3-2 at Tottenham Hotspur

reports.standfirst: Aston Villa won 3-2 at Tottenham for their first win of the season, lifting Emery's side clear of the bottom three, where without a win Spurs remain.
reports.account:
Aston Villa were 3-0 up with 11 minutes left, and Tottenham then scored twice from the 80th minute.
Sávio drew a save with a shot inside the box, set up by Dominic Solanke, in the 11th minute.
Johan Manzambi tested the keeper four minutes later, Victor Lindelöf the provider.
Pedro Porro went off injured in the 19th minute.
Emiliano Buendía saw a shot saved in the 27th minute, Nicolas Jackson supplying him.
Manzambi struck just before the interval, Boubacar Kamara the passer, for 1-0.
Mohammed Kudus came on at half-time.
Kudus had the ball in the net on the hour, made by Solanke, but a video review ruled it out.
Jackson made it 2-0 midway through the second half, Manzambi turning provider on this one.
Buendía added the third with 11 minutes left, John McGinn feeding him from a break down the flank, and he struck it right-footed from outside the box into the top corner.
Conor Gallagher came on with six minutes remaining.
Gallagher pulled one back four minutes from time, Kudus the maker.
Jan Paul van Hecke headed home Andy Robertson's set-piece cross deep into stoppage time for 3-2.

sections.head: Buendía finds range
sections.pitch: Buendía had three efforts across the match and created three chances for others besides his goal.
sections.stake: Notemail has him, worth seven points that day.

sections.head: Manzambi makes mark
sections.pitch: Manzambi took his first league start of the campaign and was withdrawn, having had four attempts and laid on Jackson's second.
sections.stake: He belongs to nobody in the league and has one league goal this season.

sections.head: Sávio busy, unrewarded
sections.pitch: Sávio had three shots and set up four openings for team-mates across the match.
sections.stake: He is going unclaimed in the league.

reports.standfirst: Brighton beat Arsenal 3-0 to push them off top place and hand them a first defeat of the season.
reports.account:
Pascal Groß opened the scoring after 31 minutes. Charalampos Kostoulas laid it back and Groß struck it right-footed from outside the box into the middle of the goal.
Kostoulas doubled it on half-time, finishing a Diego Gómez pass on the break.
Chema Andrés headed in a Groß corner after 57 minutes to make it 3-0.
Pascal Struijk met a De Cuyper corner with a header from close range after 68 minutes, off target.
Riccardo Calafiori then nodded a Declan Rice corner wide from inside the six-yard box, and Kai Havertz headed a Bukayo Saka corner off target too.
Struijk went off injured four minutes from time.
Malick Yalcouyé struck the woodwork after 90 minutes.

sections.head: Groß runs it
sections.pitch: Pascal Groß has three league goals this season and crossed the corner that Chema Andrés headed in.
sections.stake: 123 have him for 11 points, and in their head-to-head this period 123 lead test2 38-34.

sections.head: Kostoulas among the goals
sections.pitch: Charalampos Kostoulas has two league goals this season, had four shots and set up the second before he was taken off.
sections.stake: test31121 have him for eight points.

reports.standfirst: Everton beat 10-man Ipswich 1-0, a fifth match unbeaten for Moyes's side.
reports.account:
Brennan Johnson pulled an early chance off target in the 5th minute, Harrison Armstrong threading him through from inside the box.
Thierno Barry put Everton ahead in the 11th minute, James Tarkowski the provider.
Leif Davis shot over from the six-yard box in the 38th minute, Abdul Fatawu crossing.
Barry had the ball in the net again after 58 minutes, Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall the maker, but a video review ruled it out.
Abdul Fatawu was sent off for a second booking midway through the second half.
Dewsbury-Hall put a header wide from the six-yard box with 14 minutes left, Tyler Dibling the crosser.
Emersonn went off injured with nine minutes left.

sections.head: Barry strikes early
sections.pitch: Barry had three efforts across the match and now stands on two league goals this season.
sections.stake: Notemail has him, worth six points.

sections.head: Pickford keeps clean sheet
sections.pitch: Pickford made four saves to keep his goal intact.
sections.stake: test3 has him, at seven points; in the head-to-head this period test4 lead test3 26-24.

reports.standfirst: Newcastle held off Hull 2-1 for a first home win of the season, ending Hull's unbeaten start.
reports.account:
Joe Willock struck after three minutes, converting a Harvey Barnes pass.
Lewis Hall made it 2-0 four minutes later on the break, again teed up by Barnes.
Hall shot off target from the six-yard box after 33 minutes, Jacob Murphy crossing.
Yoane Wissa saw a penalty saved just before the interval.
Sven Botman was denied a header from a Hall cross after 52 minutes.
Mohamed Belloumi shot off target on the break at the other end.
Mohamed-Ali Cho came on midway through the half and pulled one back a minute on. Belloumi threaded him through and he finished left-footed from inside the box, low into the corner.
Sean Steur and then Matias Fernandez-Pardo both went off injured.

sections.head: Barnes turns creator
sections.pitch: Harvey Barnes made both Newcastle goals and three chances in all.
sections.stake: testf has him for eight points.

sections.head: Belloumi busy in defeat
sections.pitch: Mohamed Belloumi had five shots and set up Cho's goal before being taken off.
sections.stake: Notemail has him for four points.

reports.standfirst: Coventry won 1-0 at Nottingham Forest for a first win and first clean sheet of the season, though still in the bottom three.
reports.account:
Dan Ndoye shot off target inside the box after 13 minutes, Neco Williams nodding it to him.
Brandon Thomas-Asante headed a Jay Dasilva cross off target after 28 minutes.
Murillo headed a Williams corner off target from the six-yard box.
Dasilva settled it after 55 minutes. Carl Rushworth found him and he finished left-footed from inside the box into the middle of the goal.
Igor Jesus seemed to have levelled four minutes from time, but a video review ruled it out.

sections.head: Rushworth turns provider
sections.pitch: Carl Rushworth set up Dasilva's winner and kept a clean sheet at the back.
sections.stake: test211 has him on the bench, so his points did not count.

sections.head: Gibbs-White carves without reward
sections.pitch: Morgan Gibbs-White made six chances, none of them converted.
sections.stake: test3 has him.

stories.headline: Chelsea left holding the ball
stories.deck: Brentford beat Chelsea 3-0

reports.standfirst: Brentford beat Chelsea 3-0, three second-half goals lifting Keith Andrews's unbeaten side above the visitors and into third.
reports.account:
Igor Thiago had the first sight of goal after five minutes, meeting a Yehor Yarmoliuk cross with a shot that flew off target.
Pedro Neto replied for Chelsea after 10 minutes, working a chance from a Danny Welbeck pass, but Caoimhín Kelleher saved.
Just before half-time Keane Lewis-Potter was set up by Jaidon Anthony, only for his shot to be turned away.
The opening goal came after 61 minutes. Jannik Schuster headed a corner across goal and Jaidon Anthony finished for 1-0.
With seven minutes left Thiago made it 2-0 on the break, Brentford's second in the space of 11 minutes.
Fábio Carvalho came on three minutes from time.
Four minutes into added time Carvalho added the third. From within the six-yard box he swept a right-footed finish into the top corner for 3-0.

sections.head: Schade threatens
sections.pitch: Kevin Schade had three shots without a goal.
sections.stake: 123 has him for eight points, and 123 lead their head-to-head 38-34 this period.

sections.head: Schuster provides
sections.pitch: Jannik Schuster made the opening goal with his header from the corner.
sections.stake: He is a free agent.

sections.head: Thiago among the goals
sections.pitch: Igor Thiago had three shots across the match, one of them a goal.
sections.stake: He too is a free agent.

stories.deck: Every club's expected starting eleven for the round, match by match.
stories.body: All 10 of the round's matches, with both sides named.

stories.headline: Thursday and Friday Pressers
stories.deck: James Tarkowski banned for Everton, suspended rather than injured
stories.body:
James Tarkowski is suspended for Everton, banned rather than injured.

David Moyes said Tarkowski will be missed for his leadership but that it is the one position where Everton have cover.

teamNews.line: Cody Gakpo is ruled out with a muscle problem and Victor Munoz is a doubt with his knee, but Conor Bradley and Giovanni Leoni are both over their knee injuries.
Matty Cash returns to contention for Aston Villa.
Tino is on the way back, with two days to decide whether he is ready to start or needs more time.

quote.text: Tino, for example, is now on the way back but we need to see in two days if he is ready from the start or if needs more time. I don’t want to rush something.

teamNews.line: Crystal Palace are without Jean-Philippe Mateta, Yeremy and Will Hughes through suspension.
Benjamin Lecomte is ruled out for Fulham.
Leif Davis is available again for Ipswich Town.

David Raya is back from his shoulder injury with his fitness still uncertain hours before the game, Max Dowman is suspended, and William Saliba's time on the pitch should extend with a week or 10 days more training.

men.name: David Raya
men.note: back from a shoulder injury; fitness unconfirmed with hours to go

quote.text: I don’t know, we still have a few hours for the game, so we’re just trying to get everybody back.

teamNews.line: Marcus Rashford is over his hip problem, but Bruno Fernandes has a virus, missed training and awaits a decision.

quote.text: He’s affected by a virus from Portugal. He finished the game a little bit with a problem, and, today, he cannot be part of the training session.

teamNews.line: Antoine Semenyo is already on the pitch and very close to a return, and Manchester City have no new injuries.

quote.text: He’s already on the pitch, he’s very close, hopefully can be next week. The rest, they are all okay.

teamNews.line: Kaoru Mitoma is unavailable but could be training with the team within one or two weeks, Stefanos Tzimas is over his knee injury and Olivier Boscagli is a doubt with illness.

quote.text: He’s getting really close, so I think in the next one or two weeks he’ll be back training with the team. That’s very positive.

teamNews.line: Sávio faces a long spell out, Tosin has resumed training after his calf injury and Lucas Bergvall's availability is undecided.

men.name: Tosin
men.note: back from a calf injury; trained Friday, next day unclear

men.name: Sávio
men.note: 50, 60 or 80 days; same injury, long time out

quote.text: Savio [is out]. Tosin started today with us. I don’t know tomorrow, we analyse the situation. Lucas Bergvall is sick, I don’t know if tomorrow he’s available to play or not.
Tarky will be a miss because of his leadership and a lot of things he brings to the side, so we’ll miss him, but, look, it’s the one position where we have got some cover, so we’re not short there.

teamNews.line: Alderete has been assessed and is fine, a few players are on the edge with viruses, and Romaine Mundle and Daniel Ballard are running on the pitch with no rush on their return.

quote.text: [Alderete] has been assessed this morning and he’s fine, but at the minute, we have a few players just on the edge with viruses.

teamNews.line: Tim Iroegbunam faces about three months out after surgery and Elliot Stroud misses out with a knee injury, but Charlie Hughes and Ilyas Ansah return.

men.name: Ilyas Ansah
men.note: back from a back injury; in training, needs time after three months without a game

quote.text: He had surgery on Tuesday, it went good. The recovery is about three months.

teamNews.line: Igor Thiago is suspended, and Antoni Milambo and Josh Dasilva are back from injury and building fitness towards the first-team squad.

men.name: Antoni Milambo
men.note: back from a knee injury; 45 minutes in the B-team game, building fitness

men.name: Josh Dasilva
men.note: back from a hamstring injury; 45 minutes in the B-team game, building fitness

quote.text: They played 45 minutes the other night in the B-team game. They both played well and came through the game well.

teamNews.line: João Pedro, Jorrel Hato, Maxence Lacroix and Reece James are all ruled out, and Moisés Caicedo has trained and is available.

quote.text: It’s one less week than the last game, so we are closer to recovering, but not for this game.

teamNews.line: Leeds United report no injuries, with Anton back in full team training after a broken toe and a broken finger.

quote.text: As it stands, everyone’s available [and] came through the last gameday and also through the week. No injuries to report.

teamNews.line: Taiwo Awoniyi is unavailable with the extent of his injury not yet known, Haji Wright is a few weeks away and Josh Eccles has had a small operation.

quote.text: We don’t know the significance of it yet but he won’t be available for the weekend. I’d rather give you the details when I know them fully.

stories.headline: Go forth and multiply
stories.deck: Brentford beat Everton 4-0

reports.standfirst: Brentford beat Everton 4-0 to climb to sixth, a point above the Toffees in ninth.
reports.account: Brentford went in at the interval two goals to the good and scored twice more in the second half, keeping a clean sheet against Everton throughout.

stories.headline: Hull's hull stays watertight all night
stories.deck: Hull City beat Brighton & Hove Albion 2-0

reports.standfirst: Hull City beat Brighton & Hove Albion 2-0, with Brighton still second on 22 points.
reports.account: The sides went in goalless at half-time, and Hull scored both goals after the interval.

reports.standfirst: Manchester United, without a win in nine, lost 4-0 to Liverpool.
reports.account: Liverpool led 2-0 at half-time. Two more goals followed after the interval.

stories.headline: City levels the field at last
stories.deck: Manchester City and Fulham drew 1-1

reports.standfirst: Manchester City came from behind to draw 1-1 with Fulham.
reports.account: Fulham held the lead at the interval. City levelled once play resumed, and the scores stayed level until the final whistle.

reports.standfirst: Sunderland remain in the bottom three after a 0-0 draw with Aston Villa.
reports.account: Aston Villa and Sunderland were goalless at the interval, and the second half went the same way, the match ending 0-0.

reports.standfirst: AFC Bournemouth beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 for a fifth successive league win.
reports.account: The Cherries led 2-0 by the interval, which was also the final score.

reports.standfirst: Leeds United beat Chelsea 4-1, pulling clear after the sides were level at half-time.
reports.account: Chelsea and Leeds were 1-1 when the teams went off for the interval. Leeds scored the rest of the goals after the resumption to win 4-1.

reports.standfirst: Coventry City beat Crystal Palace 3-2, leaving the Eagles 20th, in the bottom three and without a win in five.
reports.account: Coventry City and Crystal Palace were 2-2 at half-time, and Coventry added a third after the break to take the match 3-2.

reports.standfirst: Tottenham Hotspur saw off Ipswich Town 2-0, leaving the Tractor Boys 16th and five matches without a victory.
reports.account: Tottenham went in at half-time 1-0 up on Ipswich, and a second goal after the restart settled it at 2-0.

reports.standfirst: Newcastle United and Arsenal drew 2-2, the Gunners staying top and unbeaten in six.
reports.account: Arsenal led 1-0 at half-time. Newcastle found two goals after half-time and Arsenal one more, leaving the score 2-2.

stories.headline: Pigs post new low yet still climb
stories.deck: The Truffle Pigs beat its_ohi 41-38

matchups.standfirst: The Truffle Pigs began the gameweek seventh in the table, and its_ohi began it first.
paragraphs: Hull City's Oli McBurnie was auto-subbed for its_ohi and was the best player on the pitch, with both goals in a 2-0 win against Brighton. The Truffle Pigs had three Brighton men in that match, and all three blanked.

Their answer came from Man Utd's 4-0 defeat at Liverpool. Liverpool's Alisson Becker was subbed on for The Truffle Pigs and was among the best on show, and his clean sheet was worth eight points. Liverpool's Ronald Araujo, another of theirs, also kept a clean sheet in that match.

Brentford's Kristoffer Ajer, signed by its_ohi this gameweek, was in a defence that conceded nothing to Everton. its_ohi slip to second, and The Truffle Pigs, on their lowest total of the season, rise to fourth with three wins in a row.

matchups.standfirst: Liverpool's Florian Wirtz came off the bench for domeitalycoach and was the best man in a 4-0 defeat of Man Utd, his goal and assist worth 12 points.
paragraphs: Bayern Bru had Liverpool's Bradley Barcola in that game, and his lone assist could not live with Wirtz's haul.
Brentford's Keane Lewis-Potter did most for Bayern Bru from their bench, with two goals in 73 minutes of a home win against Everton, where nobody played better.

domeitalycoach's Jack Rudoni answered with two assists in Coventry City's 3-2 win against Crystal Palace. domeitalycoach climb from ninth to seventh with the season's highest total, and its_ohi come next. Bayern Bru have lost four in a row and are bottom of the pile.

matchups.standfirst: GlengarryHearts' 28-point win is the biggest of the season.
paragraphs: Bournemouth's James Hill and Marcus Tavernier, reserves on opposite sides here, had an assist apiece in a 2-0 win against Nott'm Forest.
Hill added a clean sheet and was the best player in that match, which gave GlengarryHearts the better of the pairing by nine points to 6.
AtleticoTimHortons had their poorest gameweek yet and slip from sixth to eighth. GlengarryHearts started the gameweek tenth, and all of that moves them a single place, to ninth.

matchups.verdict: If anyone can, Bannan can beat Cowthenbeef 37-29
matchups.standfirst: The table now has If anyone can, Bannan can first and its_ohi second.
paragraphs: Leeds's Dominic Calvert-Lewin came into the Cowthenbeef side from the bench, and his goal and assist in Leeds's win at Chelsea were worth nine points.

Cowthenbeef's three Arsenal men all blanked. Spurs's Antonín Kinsky, a reserve for If anyone can, Bannan can, was one of the best on the pitch, and Ipswich Town lost 2-0 without beating him. If anyone can, Bannan can's Taiwo Awoniyi, signed this gameweek, had a goal in the five-goal match between Coventry City and Crystal Palace.
Cowthenbeef slip from third to fifth after their fewest points yet this season, and the pressure mounts. If anyone can, Bannan can are five without defeat.

matchups.verdict: The Raccoons beat Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza 39-21
matchups.standfirst: Everton's Jordan Pickford and James Tarkowski both blanked for Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza.
paragraphs: Both came into the side automatically, and Everton conceded four at Brentford. Pickford played all 90 minutes for one point, and Tarkowski was one of the poorest on the pitch in 39 minutes for -2 points.
Đorđe Petrović kept a clean sheet for The Raccoons in Bournemouth's 2-0 win over Nott'm Forest, where Justin Kluivert scored.
Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza sink to sixth on their lowest score of the season, and The Raccoons rise to third.

stories.headline: Lawro's Predictions: GW12
stories.deck: Lawro backs its_ohi in the Milan Derby and Bayern Bru against Cowthenbeef, both times against the favourites.
stories.body: One from three last week. Nought from one on the gut, which was about what it deserved. Match of the Day had me on a Saturday night. A draft league has me on a Friday, before its lock.

ties.line:
domeitalycoach are seventh and turn up when they feel like it. They call this the Milan Derby, which is a grand title for neighbours. domeitalycoach send Van Hecke to Sunderland and Smith to Fulham, and I wouldn't trust either on his travels.

its_ohi lost to The Truffle Pigs last time, and second is only somewhere to fall from. its_ohi's Mitchell has Hull City at home. Hull City scoring? Hardly. its_ohi also send Suzuki to Ipswich Town, who frighten nobody.

Mitchell and Suzuki face two attacks with nothing in them, so I'm going against the favourites here.

Muharemović has Coventry City at home for If anyone can, Bannan can, and Coventry City barely cross halfway. It's the Tim Hortons Derby, and top of the table get the easy end. If anyone can, Bannan can have Jorgen Strand Larsen off the waiver list, a polite name for leftovers.

GlengarryHearts went through AtleticoTimHortons like a dose of salts last week, and eighth is where that leaves them. AtleticoTimHortons have Trafford in goal for Leeds United, home to the same harmless Coventry City. De Cuyper has gone quiet for AtleticoTimHortons and Brighton & Hove Albion alike.

I doubt Coventry City lay a glove on Muharemović, so it's If anyone can, Bannan can.

Away at Ipswich Town is soft going, and The Truffle Pigs send N.Jackson there. Ipswich Town defend like a door left on the latch.

The Raccoons are the champions, and they've looked it once in a while. Haaland goes to Arsenal for The Raccoons after two quiet games, and that defence will hardly wake him. Barry has two goals and an assist for The Raccoons, and Everton aren't used to that.

With N.Jackson at Ipswich Town and Haaland up against Arsenal, I'll go with The Truffle Pigs.

I can't warm to Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza after two defeats running, though Justin has Coventry City at home. Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza have Gabriel at Arsenal against Manchester City, and I'll watch it through my fingers. It'll be a whole match of two sides frightened to lose.

GlengarryHearts are ninth and beat AtleticoTimHortons last week, so naturally everybody thinks they've turned a corner. GlengarryHearts have Anderson in that one for Manchester City, and Barnes at Brighton & Hove Albion with Newcastle United.

Brighton & Hove Albion against Newcastle United is where this gets decided, and Barnes puts GlengarryHearts over the line.

Cowthenbeef are the side everybody expects to win this, and I'm not having it. Calvert-Lewin has scored once and made one in his last two for Cowthenbeef. Leeds United forwards always go back to type, mind you.

Bayern Bru are bottom after four defeats running, and they've earned every one. Barcola and Munoz go to Everton with Liverpool, and Bayern Bru have them both.

Bayern Bru play the better football, with Barcola and Munoz passing Everton dizzy.

stories.headline: Alysson through the looking glass
stories.deck: Alysson's 13 points led a Bin XI that scored 78, more than any side in the league.
stories.body:
Alysson hauled in Aston Villa's 4-4 draw away to Manchester United: a goal and two assists in 70 minutes, two of his three shots on target, and two interceptions besides. Leon Goretzka scored in the same eight-goal match and sits in the middle behind him.

The back of the side belongs to Sunderland, whose 1-0 win over Chelsea gave Robin Roefs, Trai Hume and Reinildo a clean sheet and carried it into the middle through Noah Sadiki and Luke O'Nien. Roefs was dropped by Bayern Bru ahead of gameweek 8. Nico Elvedi and Costinha kept clean sheets for Leeds United and Brighton & Hove Albion. Nottingham Forest's 3-1 win over Manchester City supplied a goal from Jair Cunha in defence and an assist from Xaver Schlager in midfield. Alysson leads the line alone.

stories.headline: Dorgu's nod settles eight-goal argument
stories.deck: Manchester United and Aston Villa drew 4-4

reports.standfirst: Manchester United came back from two down to draw 4-4 with Aston Villa.
reports.account:
Alysson put Aston Villa ahead in the 1st minute, converting John McGinn's pass left-footed from inside the box. Nicolas Jackson doubled the lead at a set piece, a right-footed finish from close range in the 4th minute. Bruno Fernandes pulled one back from the penalty spot after 16 minutes, his kick going down the middle. Youri Tielemans levelled just before half-time with a left-footed shot inside the box from Noussair Mazraoui's pass.
McGinn restored Villa's lead early in the second half, sending a left-footed penalty low into the corner. Leon Goretzka made it 4-2 after 53 minutes, a left-footed finish low inside the corner from close range off Jackson's set-piece pass. Joshua Zirkzee, on for Bryan Mbeumo, made it 4-3 two minutes into stoppage time, converting a cross from fellow substitute Patrick Dorgu left-footed. Dorgu, on for Diogo Dalot, then headed in Fernandes's corner from close range deep into stoppage time.

sections.head: Alysson strikes first
sections.pitch: Alysson now has two league goals this season, and the opener came from one of his three shots. He also earned one defensive point.
sections.stake: A free agent, 13 points.

sections.head: Dorgu's goal and assist
sections.pitch: Patrick Dorgu came off the bench to have a hand in both of Manchester United's late goals, the only substitute in the match to make one and score one.
sections.stake: A free agent, 10 points.

sections.head: Goretzka scores Villa's fourth
sections.pitch: Leon Goretzka scored Aston Villa's fourth and final goal, the one that put them two in front for a second time before Manchester United replied twice.
sections.stake: A free agent, seven points.

reports.standfirst: Brighton & Hove Albion beat Brentford 2-0, adding a second after Igor Thiago was sent off.
reports.account: Diego Gómez put Brighton ahead after 15 minutes, his left-footed shot from outside the box finding the top corner. Igor Thiago received his marching orders eight minutes after Gómez's goal, leaving Brentford with 10 men. Pascal Groß doubled the lead against 10 men in the 42nd minute, converting from the spot right-footed into the top corner.

sections.head: Groß creates openings
sections.pitch: Pascal Groß's goal took him to four in the league this term, with five chances also created for Brighton.
sections.stake: AtleticoTimHortons has him, for eight points, and drew 40-40 with The Raccoons.

sections.head: Vuskovic, Dunk unbreached
sections.pitch: Luka Vuskovic and Lewis Dunk were on from first whistle to last without Brighton conceding, and Dunk collected a defensive point too.
sections.stake: The Truffle Pigs has Vuskovic, for nine points; Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has Dunk, for six points, and lost 48-43 to The Truffle Pigs.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Vuskovic 9 (The Truffle Pigs), Gómez 8 (Cowthenbeef), Groß 8 (AtleticoTimHortons), Verbruggen 6 (Cowthenbeef)

reports.standfirst: Liverpool win 3-1 at Crystal Palace, Alexis Mac Allister's header opening the scoring.
reports.account: Alexis Mac Allister put Liverpool ahead after 40 minutes, heading Dominik Szoboszlai's set-piece cross through the middle from inside the area. Florian Wirtz added a second after 54 minutes, finishing Bradley Barcola's cross right-footed and low inside the post. Alexander Isak struck a third one minute from time, converting Wirtz's pass on the break with his right foot through the centre. Eddie Nketiah, on from the bench for Jørgen Strand Larsen, replied deep into added time with a right-footed penalty into the bottom corner.

sections.head: Szoboszlai's six chances
sections.pitch: Dominik Szoboszlai created six chances in all across the match, his set-piece delivery for Liverpool's opening goal being one of them.
sections.stake: domeitalycoach has him on the bench, for six points, and lost 38-37 to If anyone can, Bannan can.

sections.head: Mac Allister, Barcola deliver
sections.pitch: Alexis Mac Allister was paid the maximum two defensive points and had three shots. Bradley Barcola matched him with three shots of his own.
sections.stake: its_ohi has Mac Allister, for eight points; Bayern Bru has Barcola, for five points, and lost 55-30 to its_ohi.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Wirtz 11 (domeitalycoach), Mac Allister 8 (its_ohi), Isak 6 (GlengarryHearts), Araujo 6 (The Truffle Pigs)

reports.standfirst: AFC Bournemouth won 2-1 at Ipswich Town, with Evanilson scoring early on.
reports.account: Evanilson put AFC Bournemouth ahead after five minutes, his right-footed shot from inside the six-yard box going low beside the post. Leif Davis turned the ball into his own net just after half-time for 2-0. Jack Clarke, introduced for Jaden Philogene, scored from the spot with 17 minutes left, his right-footed kick going along the ground into the corner.

sections.head: Evanilson's fifth league goal
sections.pitch: Evanilson's opener was his fifth league goal of the campaign and the first of four shots he had in the match.
sections.stake: If anyone can, Bannan can has him, for seven points.

sections.head: Clarke converts, Christie shoots
sections.pitch: Jack Clarke's goal from the bench was his second of the league season. Ryan Christie tried three shots for AFC Bournemouth.
sections.stake: Clarke, a free agent, five points; Christie, a free agent, six points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Evanilson 7 (If anyone can, Bannan can), Christie 6, Clarke 5, Ouattara 4

reports.standfirst: Sunderland beat Chelsea 1-0 with Enzo Le Fée's first-half penalty but stay in the bottom three.
reports.account: Granit Xhaka went off injured in the 4th minute. Brian Brobbey met Chemsdine Talbi's cross from close range after 15 minutes, his shot going off target. Enzo Le Fée put Sunderland ahead after 36 minutes, converting from the spot, low and right-footed into the corner.

sections.head: Mukiele keeps clean sheet
sections.pitch: Nordi Mukiele was on the pitch from start to finish without Sunderland conceding, and the league paid him one defensive point.
sections.stake: GlengarryHearts has him on the bench, for seven points, and lost 48-41 to Cowthenbeef.

sections.head: Le Fée's third strike
sections.pitch: Enzo Le Fée's goal was his third of the league campaign, and alongside it he earned one point for his effort at the back.
sections.stake: GlengarryHearts has him, for nine points.

stories.headline: Reserve judgement
stories.deck: If anyone can, Bannan can beat domeitalycoach 38-37

matchups.verdict: If anyone can, Bannan can beat domeitalycoach 38-37
matchups.standfirst: Liverpool's Dominik Szoboszlai was a domeitalycoach reserve, so the six points from his assist did not count, while Doku's two in the eleven did.
paragraphs: That assist came in Liverpool's 3-1 win at Crystal Palace, where Liverpool's Florian Wirtz had a goal and an assist of his own for domeitalycoach. Fulham's Timothy Castagne played for them against If anyone can, Bannan can, the side who drafted him.
Bournemouth's Francisco Evanilson had one of the goals in a 2-1 win at Ipswich Town for If anyone can, Bannan can. Arsenal's David Raya let nothing past him at home to Hull City.
That makes four wins in a row for If anyone can, Bannan can, and Cowthenbeef are the next to face them.

matchups.standfirst: Everton's Thierno Barry had a hand in all three Everton goals at home to Coventry City, and AtleticoTimHortons still matched The Raccoons in the Cold Tea Classic.
paragraphs: Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall struck Everton's third in the 81st minute, which gave The Raccoons a second man from that 3-1 win. Vitalii Mykolenko made one of the goals in it, so AtleticoTimHortons had a share of the same match.
Brighton's Pascal Gross had one of the goals in a 2-0 win at home to Brentford, worth eight points to AtleticoTimHortons. James Trafford conceded nothing when Leeds beat Spurs 1-0.

matchups.verdict: The Truffle Pigs beat Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza 48-43
matchups.standfirst: The Truffle Pigs went into the Irish Wilderness Derby eighth in the table, against a Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza side in third.
paragraphs: Aston Villa's Nicolas Jackson scored once and set up another in the 4-4 draw at Man Utd, worth nine points to The Truffle Pigs. Luka Vuskovic's assist came with a clean sheet in Brighton's 2-0 win over Brentford. Noni Madueke, signed by The Truffle Pigs this gameweek, set up the only goal of Arsenal's 1-0 win over Hull City.
Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza have Nott'm Forest's Liam Delap, who scored twice in the 3-1 win over Man City. Their run of three wins ended against The Truffle Pigs.

matchups.standfirst: Brighton's Diego Gomez beat Brentford's Caoimhín Kelleher in the 15th minute for Cowthenbeef, and GlengarryHearts lost their goalkeeper's clean sheet with it.
paragraphs: Kelleher came away with three points from the 2-0, and Bart Verbruggen was unbeaten at the other end of that match for Cowthenbeef.
Sunderland's Brian Brobbey laid on the only goal of the 1-0 win at home to Chelsea for Cowthenbeef, and the man who finished it played for GlengarryHearts.
Alexander Isak beat the Crystal Palace goalkeeper in the 89th minute of Liverpool's 3-1 win for GlengarryHearts. Barnes drew a blank.

matchups.standfirst: Aston Villa's John McGinn had a goal and an assist in the 4-4 draw at Man Utd, and Bayern Bru had nobody to match him.
paragraphs: its_ohi also had Man Utd's Bruno Fernandes at the other end of that draw, with a goal and an assist, and Youri Tielemans had another of the eight goals. Mac Allister found a goal in Liverpool's 3-1 win at Crystal Palace.
Arsenal's Martin Ødegaard decided a 1-0 win with his goal for Bayern Bru, and Mbeumo blanked.
This is its_ohi's best total of the season. Bayern Bru have lost three in a row, and domeitalycoach come next with the hot seat warming.

stories.headline: Delap of honour
stories.deck: Nottingham Forest beat Manchester City 3-1

reports.standfirst: Nottingham Forest beat Manchester City 3-1 on the strength of two goals in 12 minutes early in the first half.
reports.account:
Forest went ahead after six minutes, Jair Cunha striking low into the corner with his left foot from inside the box. Twelve minutes after Cunha's goal they broke, and Xaver Schlager's pass sent Liam Delap through to finish high into the middle of the goal with his right foot, leaving City two goals down.
City pulled one back after 52 minutes through Rayan Cherki, who found the top corner with his left foot from inside the penalty area. Forest broke again 17 minutes from time, and Morgan Gibbs-White released Delap to finish into the top corner for his second.

sections.head: Delap's double
sections.pitch: Liam Delap now has three league goals this season, two of them from this match, and his three shots brought both.
sections.stake: Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has him on the bench, for 10 points.

sections.head: Cunha's opener
sections.pitch: Jair Cunha shot three times in all, one of those efforts bringing the opening goal, which matched Delap's count of three shots for Forest.
sections.stake: A free agent, eight points.

sections.head: Schlager's assist
sections.pitch: Xaver Schlager took both of the defensive points on offer, the most any match pays, alongside the pass that sent Delap clear for the second goal.
sections.stake: A free agent, seven points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Delap 10 (Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza), Cunha 8, Schlager 7, Cherki 7 (Cowthenbeef)

reports.standfirst: Leeds United beat Tottenham Hotspur 1-0 through a late goal from the substitute Noah Okafor.
reports.account: Mathys Tel went off injured for Tottenham just before half-time. Dominic Calvert-Lewin turned a close-range shot from a corner wide early in the second half. After 79 minutes Noah Okafor, on as a substitute for Lukas Nmecha, put Leeds ahead with a low right-footed finish into the bottom corner.

sections.head: Justin's clean sheet
sections.pitch: James Justin completed the match without Leeds conceding, and he was paid one of the two defensive points that any match can offer.
sections.stake: Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has him on the bench, for seven points.

sections.head: Trafford saves, Porro defends
sections.pitch: James Trafford made four saves and was beaten by nothing Tottenham sent his way, so Leeds kept their goal intact across the match. For the losing side, Pedro Porro earned one point for his defending, half of the most a single match pays.
sections.stake: The Raccoons has Porro on the bench, for six points; AtleticoTimHortons has Trafford, for eight points against The Raccoons.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Trafford 8 (AtleticoTimHortons), Ampadu 7 (GlengarryHearts), Justin 7 (Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza), Elvedi 7

reports.standfirst: Arsenal beat Hull City 1-0, a second-half goal from Martin Ødegaard settling the match.
reports.account: John Egan headed a Regan Slater corner off target from close in after two minutes. Hull lost Semi Ajayi, forced off hurt after 69 minutes. Martin Ødegaard then won it for Arsenal after 72 minutes, a low right-footed shot from inside the six-yard box going into the corner.

sections.head: Ajayi off, Konsa unbreached
sections.pitch: Semi Ajayi and Ezri Konsa each came away with a defensive point, half the maximum on offer in a match. Konsa stayed on from the first whistle to the last for Arsenal, and the Gunners did not concede in all that time.
sections.stake: Bayern Bru has Ajayi on the bench, for seven points; its_ohi has Konsa, for seven points against Bayern Bru.

sections.head: Madueke creates, Magalhães unbeaten
sections.pitch: Noni Madueke shot four times and also set up four chances for teammates in the Arsenal attack. Gabriel Magalhães also saw the match through with Arsenal conceding nothing, another player alongside Konsa to go the distance without a goal against.
sections.stake: The Truffle Pigs claimed Madueke on Wednesday, for six points; Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has Magalhães, for six points against The Truffle Pigs.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Ødegaard 8 (Bayern Bru), Konsa 7 (its_ohi), Raya 7 (If anyone can, Bannan can), Ajayi 7 (Bayern Bru)

reports.standfirst: Fulham drew 1-1 with Newcastle United after coming from behind, the substitute Rodrigo Muniz cancelling out Jacob Murphy's strike.
reports.account:
Fulham lost Josh King, who went off injured after 72 minutes. Jacob Murphy put Newcastle ahead after 80 minutes with a low left-footed shot from outside the box. Three minutes after Murphy's goal Rodrigo Muniz, on for Gonzalo García, levelled from within six yards with his right foot, low into a corner.
Malick Thiaw came off hurt after 85 minutes. Deep into stoppage time Matias Fernandez-Pardo also had to go, with every change made.

sections.head: Murphy's goal
sections.pitch: Jacob Murphy added a defensive point to his goal, one of the two any single match can pay, so he contributed at both ends for Newcastle.
sections.stake: A free agent, seven points.

sections.head: King's injury
sections.pitch: Josh King was the first of three players to go off hurt in this match, and the only Fulham man among them, the other two being Newcastle's.
sections.stake: The Raccoons claimed him on Thursday, for three points.

stories.headline: Here we go! Declan Rice to its_ohi
stories.deck: its_ohi get Declan Rice from Truffles for Bruno Fernandes
stories.body:
its_ohi land Declan Rice from Truffles, the Arsenal midfielder good for 48 points this season without a goal to his name. Truffles take Bruno Fernandes the other way, the Manchester United man sat on 34 points and three goals. A straight midfield swap, no further business attached.

Here we go!

stories.headline: Barry proves properly barry
stories.deck: Everton beat Coventry City 3-1

reports.standfirst: Everton recovered from a goal down to beat Coventry City 3-1.
reports.account: Yann Gboho put Coventry City ahead in the 52nd minute with a low right-footed shot from inside the box that went in at the corner. Everton were level four minutes after Gboho's goal, when Vitalii Mykolenko crossed and Thierno Barry headed the ball into the top corner of the Coventry net from within the box. Barry gave Everton the lead after 61 minutes, drilling a left-footed finish from close range into the bottom corner. With nine minutes left, Barry played a through ball to Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall, whose low left-footed shot from a tight angle found the corner.

sections.head: Barry double, Mykolenko assist
sections.pitch: Thierno Barry had six shots, and his pair took him to six league goals for the campaign, alongside the pass that set up Dewsbury-Hall. Vitalii Mykolenko earned a defensive point to go with the cross for the leveller.
sections.stake: The Raccoons has Barry, for 13 points; AtleticoTimHortons has Mykolenko, for six points against The Raccoons.

sections.head: Dewsbury-Hall's third goal
sections.pitch: Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall had three shots in all, and his late goal lifted his Premier League total for the season to three.
sections.stake: The Raccoons has him, for seven points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Barry 13 (The Raccoons), Dewsbury-Hall 7 (The Raccoons), Mykolenko 6 (AtleticoTimHortons), Torp 4

stories.headline: Barry buries a set piece
stories.deck: Everton won 1-0 at Newcastle United

reports.standfirst: Everton beat Newcastle United 1-0 for their first away win of the season.
reports.account: Jake O'Brien headed wide from inside the six-yard box just before the interval, meeting a cross from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall. Thierno Barry gave Everton the lead just after half-time, his right-footed finish from close range going into the middle of the goal after a set piece. Jacob Ramsey was sent off for a second booking deep into stoppage time, leaving Newcastle with ten men.

sections.head: Tarkowski concedes nothing
sections.pitch: James Tarkowski was on the pitch from kick-off to the final whistle, and Everton conceded nothing in that time, their defence leaving Newcastle without a goal.
sections.stake: Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has him on the bench, for six points, and beat Cowthenbeef 42-36.

sections.head: Pickford keeps Newcastle out
sections.pitch: Jordan Pickford was in goal for every minute and ended the match with a clean sheet, the one goal of the match arriving at the other end.
sections.stake: Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has him, for seven points.

sections.head: Barry's fourth league goal
sections.pitch: Thierno Barry took three shots in the match, and his goal took his league total for this season to four.
sections.stake: The Raccoons has him, for six points, and beat Bayern Bru 51-29.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Pickford 7 (Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza), Branthwaite 7 (AtleticoTimHortons), O'Brien 6, Mykolenko 6 (AtleticoTimHortons)

stories.headline: Not worth a Hill of beans
stories.deck: If anyone can, Bannan can beat GlengarryHearts 41-39

matchups.verdict: If anyone can, Bannan can beat GlengarryHearts 41-39
matchups.standfirst: GlengarryHearts had the points that would have won this on their bench, where Bournemouth's James Hill was a reserve while Ampadu took none in the eleven.
paragraphs: Hill was in the Cherries' defence that conceded nothing in their 2-0 win over Leeds. Bournemouth's Francisco Evanilson scored for If anyone can, Bannan can in the 31st minute of that match, and the goal cost Ampadu his clean sheet.

Chelsea's Morgan Rogers had one of the goals in the 2-0 win over Man Utd and was among the best on the pitch. Antonín Kinsky, signed by If anyone can, Bannan can this gameweek, was not beaten by Crystal Palace, and in a match-up this narrow the new man counted.
If anyone can, Bannan can have won three in a row and are top of the pile, above its_ohi. GlengarryHearts slip to 9th.

matchups.standfirst: AtleticoTimHortons began the gameweek 6th and met an its_ohi side who started it top.
paragraphs: Everton's Jarrad Branthwaite was the best player on the pitch in the Toffees' 1-0 win at Newcastle, with Vitalii Mykolenko alongside him at the back for AtleticoTimHortons. Riccardo Calafiori and Ezri Konsa both took clean sheets from Arsenal's win at Liverpool, so that match settled nothing between these sides.
Hull City's Oli McBurnie scored one and set up the other in the 2-2 draw with Ipswich Town, the best man in it. Four Aston Villa men blanked for them, and Fernandes did too.
The win takes AtleticoTimHortons to 4th with their highest score of the season. its_ohi's run of three wins is over, and they drop to 2nd.

matchups.standfirst: domeitalycoach have Arsenal's Kai Havertz, and his 16th-minute goal at Liverpool cost The Truffle Pigs the clean sheet of Liverpool's Alisson Becker.
paragraphs: Havertz was one of the best on the pitch and Becker one of the poorest, left with two points. Arsenal's Declan Rice set up the goal, and The Truffle Pigs have him too.

The Truffle Pigs won for the first time in four gameweeks with the highest score anyone has put up this season, and rose to 8th. domeitalycoach had their highest score this season and still went bottom of the pile, four without a win.

matchups.standfirst: The Raccoons had five men return and Bayern Bru one, signed only this gameweek.
paragraphs: Chelsea's Cole Palmer scored against Man Utd in the 2-0 win, and Levi Colwill was in the defence that kept them out. Đorđe Petrović took a clean sheet from Bournemouth's 2-0 win over Leeds, and Thierno Barry scored the only goal of Everton's win at Newcastle.
Andrew Robertson, signed by Bayern Bru this gameweek, gave them their only return from the 2-0 win over Crystal Palace. Haaland blanked for The Raccoons, and it cost them nothing.
The Raccoons rise to 5th on their highest score of the season. Bayern Bru drop to 7th, with its_ohi next.

matchups.standfirst: Cowthenbeef's best return came in goal, where Brighton's Bart Verbruggen kept Man City out.
paragraphs: Lewis Dunk was in the same Seagulls defence for Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza, so the 1-0 win at Man City paid both sides. Jordan Pickford was the best player in Everton's win at Newcastle, and Arsenal's Gabriel conceded nothing at Liverpool.

António Silva, signed by Cowthenbeef this gameweek, came through Bournemouth's 2-0 win over Leeds unbreached, in the match where Justin Kluivert set up a goal for Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza. Ndiaye blanked for Cowthenbeef.
Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza have won three in a row and climb to 3rd. Cowthenbeef fall three places to 6th.

stories.headline: Rice and easy for Havertz
stories.deck: Arsenal won 1-0 at Liverpool

reports.standfirst: Arsenal won 1-0 at Liverpool, a fourth win in a row taking them top.
reports.account: Mikel Arteta's Arsenal went ahead in the 16th minute when Declan Rice crossed and Kai Havertz, inside the six-yard box, sent it low into the corner with his left foot.

sections.head: Calafiori and Konsa unbreached
sections.pitch: Riccardo Calafiori and Ezri Konsa both played the whole match and Arsenal conceded nothing. Each earned two defensive points, the maximum available.
sections.stake: AtleticoTimHortons has Calafiori, for eight points; its_ohi has Konsa, for eight points against AtleticoTimHortons.

sections.head: Rice's cross, Havertz's third
sections.pitch: Declan Rice had three shots besides the cross, and earned one defensive point. Kai Havertz's goal was his third in the league this season, and he also took one defensive point.
sections.stake: The Truffle Pigs has Rice, for seven points; domeitalycoach has Havertz, for seven points against The Truffle Pigs.

sections.head: Magalhães unbeaten throughout
sections.pitch: Gabriel Magalhães went the full distance as Arsenal kept a clean sheet, and his resolute play was worth two points in that column, the most one match pays.
sections.stake: Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has him, for eight points against Cowthenbeef.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Calafiori 8 (AtleticoTimHortons), Magalhães 8 (Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza), Konsa 8 (its_ohi), Rice 7 (The Truffle Pigs)

stories.headline: Sakamoto sends Sunderland to Coventry
stories.deck: Coventry City beat Sunderland 3-1

reports.standfirst: Coventry City beat Sunderland 3-1, Tatsuhiro Sakamoto's long-range strike setting them on their way.
reports.account:
Sakamoto opened the scoring in the 17th minute, his left-footed shot from beyond the box staying low and finding the corner. It gave Coventry a lead they never gave up at any stage. stories.headline: Maddison sends Coventry to Coventry

reports.standfirst: Tottenham Hotspur beat Coventry City 3-1, with James Maddison scoring first from outside the box.
reports.account:
Maddison put Tottenham ahead after 14 minutes, taking Mohammed Kudus's pass and striking it right-footed from long range into the top corner. Jack Rudoni levelled just after half-time, turning Brandon Thomas-Asante's pass on the break low into the corner, right-footed from inside the six-yard box. Omar Marmoush restored the lead after 58 minutes, his right-footed shot from distance going low into a corner from Andy Robertson's pass. Robertson went off injured midway through the second half.
Tosin Adarabioyo followed him off hurt with 19 minutes left. Marmoush was forced off three minutes from time. Deep into stoppage time Ben Davies, on for Robertson, made it 3-1, his left-footed shot from beyond the box finding the bottom corner from Dominic Solanke's pass.

sections.head: Maddison, Davies, Rudoni score
sections.pitch: Maddison and Davies scored once each, both from outside the area, Davies having come on as a substitute earlier in the game. Rudoni's goal was his second of the league season, and the only one Coventry managed.
sections.stake: Maddison, a free agent, seven points in his first league start this season; Davies, a free agent, seven points; Rudoni, a free agent, six points.

stories.headline: domeitalycoach end up in the red
stories.deck: Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza beat domeitalycoach 36-32

matchups.standfirst: domeitalycoach had Newcastle's Lewis Hall and his four points on the bench, while Sessegnon's points counted against them.
paragraphs: Hall earned his in Newcastle's 1-0 home defeat by Aston Villa. Sessegnon played and got -2 points, so Hall's points stayed where they were.
Yasin Ayari had a goal and an assist for domeitalycoach as Brighton beat Crystal Palace 5-0, and Brighton's Lewis Dunk kept Palace out behind him for Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza.

Gabriel was part of an Arsenal defence that beat Nott'm Forest 1-0 without conceding. Gakpo did not play, so Mamadou Sangaré was auto-subbed. Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza, up from 10th to 7th, meet second-placed Bayern Bru next.

matchups.verdict: If anyone can, Bannan can beat The Raccoons 46-44
matchups.standfirst: Six points from Brighton's Jack Hinshelwood stayed on The Raccoons' bench, while Palmer gave them two from their side.
paragraphs: Hinshelwood played 19 minutes of a 5-0 defeat of Crystal Palace and got one of the goals in the 84th minute.
Bournemouth's Francisco Evanilson had a hand in both goals as Sunderland were beaten 2-0, and that settled the Big Man Bakar Derby for If anyone can, Bannan can.
Milos Kerkez came off the bench for The Raccoons and Julio Enciso subbed on for their opponents. The Raccoons fell from first to fourth and meet GlengarryHearts, who are 10th.

matchups.verdict: Bayern Bru beat The Truffle Pigs 53-49
matchups.standfirst: Bayern Bru signed Brighton's Olivier Boscagli this gameweek, and he went straight into the Steve Clarke Classic with a 5-0 home win against Crystal Palace.
paragraphs: Boscagli laid on one of the five and Palace never scored. His Brighton team-mate Luka Vuskovic did the same for The Truffle Pigs and got 11 points.
Charalampos Kostoulas added a goal and an assist from that Brighton side for The Truffle Pigs, while Stach blanked.
The Truffle Pigs fell from sixth to eighth, and Bayern Bru, now second, meet Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza.

matchups.standfirst: Cowthenbeef went top of the table this gameweek, above The Raccoons.
paragraphs: Brighton's Diego Gomez had a goal as Crystal Palace went 5-0 down, and his nine points led the way for Cowthenbeef in the Teachers' Classic. Daniel Muñoz came into their side from the bench.
Bournemouth's Marcus Tavernier got a goal as Sunderland were seen off 2-0, and Jarrad Branthwaite went in automatically for AtleticoTimHortons.
AtleticoTimHortons fell from third to fifth and meet domeitalycoach, who are ninth.

matchups.standfirst: Emiliano Martinez gave its_ohi eight points from goal, with a clean sheet among them.
paragraphs: Everton could not beat him and lost 2-0 at home.
Bournemouth's James Hill, in a GlengarryHearts side for the first time, went without conceding as Bournemouth won 2-0 against Sunderland. Alex Iwobi got the only goal as Fulham beat Hull City 1-0.

Brobbey did not play, so Youri Tielemans took his place for its_ohi. GlengarryHearts went bottom and meet The Raccoons, while its_ohi moved up from fifth to third and face Cowthenbeef, the new leaders.

stories.headline: Tavernier calls time on the wait
stories.deck: AFC Bournemouth beat Sunderland 2-0

reports.standfirst: AFC Bournemouth beat Sunderland 2-0, the visitors down to 10 men after a first-half red card.
reports.account:
Marcus Tavernier put the Cherries in front after five minutes, heading Evanilson's pass straight down the middle. Sunderland lost Kevin Danso to a red card 12 minutes after Tavernier's goal, and Régis Le Bris's side were left a goal down and a man short.
Evanilson doubled the lead just after half-time, left-footed from inside the box and through the middle. Chris Rigg went off injured for Sunderland midway through the second half.

sections.head: Evanilson's goal and assist
sections.pitch: The goal was Evanilson's second in the league this season, coming from six shots, and the league also paid him one point for defending.
sections.stake: If anyone can, Bannan can has him, for 10 points against The Raccoons.

sections.head: Tavernier's fourth goal
sections.pitch: That header took Tavernier to four for the league campaign, from three shots in the match, and his defending brought the full two points a match can pay.
sections.stake: AtleticoTimHortons has him, for eight points against Cowthenbeef.

sections.head: Hill's clean sheet
sections.pitch: James Hill was out there from first whistle to last, and Sunderland put nothing past the defence he was part of.
sections.stake: GlengarryHearts has him, for six points.

reports.standfirst: Brighton & Hove Albion beat Crystal Palace 5-0, scoring three times in the first 10 minutes.
reports.account:
Jaydee Canvot put the ball into his own net after four minutes to give Brighton the lead. Diego Gómez added another three minutes after the own goal, taking Olivier Boscagli's pass on the break and striking it right-footed from more than 35 yards, high into the net. Charalampos Kostoulas then picked out Yasin Ayari, whose shot went low into the corner after 10 minutes and gave Brighton three goals in six minutes.
Kostoulas scored himself early in the second half, a low left-footed shot that found the corner. Jack Hinshelwood, on for Pascal Groß, completed the 5-0 six minutes from time, converting a corner from close range, right-footed into the top corner.

sections.head: Boscagli, Kostoulas both supply
sections.pitch: Boscagli's pass for Gómez's long-range goal was one of three chances he laid on across the match. Kostoulas supplied Ayari and then scored himself, taking four shots in all, and that strike was the third of his league season.
sections.stake: Bayern Bru claimed Boscagli on Wednesday, for nine points; The Truffle Pigs has Kostoulas, for nine points against Bayern Bru.

sections.head: Ayari scores, Dunk defends
sections.pitch: Ayari had four shots, and his strike brings his league goals for the season to two. Lewis Dunk was credited by the league with one defensive point, half of the most that a single match pays a man.
sections.stake: domeitalycoach claimed Ayari on Friday, for 11 points; Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has Dunk, for seven points against domeitalycoach.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Ayari 11 (domeitalycoach), Vuskovic 11 (The Truffle Pigs), Boscagli 9 (Bayern Bru), Gómez 9 (Cowthenbeef)

reports.standfirst: Leeds United drew 1-1 with Manchester United, Dominic Calvert-Lewin replying to Bryan Mbeumo's opener.
reports.account: Mbeumo gave United the lead after 35 minutes, turning Youri Tielemans's cross into the bottom corner with his left foot, and Michael Carrick's side took that advantage in at half-time. Leeds were level after 51 minutes, Calvert-Lewin finishing right-footed into the middle of the goal after Tarik Muharemovic found him from a corner.

sections.head: Tielemans crosses for opener
sections.pitch: Tielemans created three chances over the match, and the cross Mbeumo turned in was the one that became an assist.
sections.stake: its_ohi has him on the bench, for five points against GlengarryHearts.

sections.head: Mbeumo strikes again
sections.pitch: The goal took Mbeumo's count for the league season to four, and it came from the three shots he tried in all.
sections.stake: Bayern Bru has him, for seven points.

keyStats.label: Points

reports.standfirst: Arsenal won 1-0 at Nottingham Forest, the substitute Noni Madueke scoring 10 minutes from time.
reports.account: Gabriel Magalhães headed wide from close range after 67 minutes, meeting Declan Rice's corner. Madueke, on for Eberechi Eze at half-time, scored the winner after 80 minutes, Rice's pass turned in right-footed, high and central. Forest lost Jair Cunha to injury five minutes after Madueke's goal.

sections.head: Rice sets up winner
sections.pitch: Rice supplied three chances in total, the corner for Magalhães's header among them, and the league paid him one defensive point.
sections.stake: The Truffle Pigs has him, for seven points.

sections.head: Konsa concedes nothing
sections.pitch: Ezri Konsa was on from start to finish and the Gunners conceded nothing, the league paying him a defensive point as well.
sections.stake: its_ohi has him, for seven points.
